examples.en: In winter I wear a warm knit.

examples.ko: 이 니트는 세탁기에 돌리면 줄어들 수 있어요.
examples.en: This knit can shrink in the washing machine.
A lot of lint balls formed on the knit.
I feel warm wearing a knit vest.
The knit comes up to the neck, so it is comfortable.
Today I wore a knit and jeans.

explain: 털실로 짠 옷에 써요. 비슷한 말로 '스웨터'가 있어요. 직접 실로 짜는 일은 '뜨개질'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I wore a thick sweater because it was cold.
phrases.nuance_ko: '니트'와 거의 같은 뜻이고, 일상 대화에서 둘 다 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Almost the same meaning as 니트, and both are common in everyday speech.

phrases.en: I wear a knit hat in winter.
phrases.nuance_ko: 털실로 짠 모자를 말할 때 '니트' 뒤에 물건 이름을 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the item name after '니트' to talk about a knitted hat.

phrases.en: I wore a knit vest over my shirt.
phrases.nuance_ko: 소매 없는 니트 옷을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a sleeveless knitted garment.

explain_en: It is used for clothes made of knitted yarn. A similar word is '스웨터'. Making it yourself with yarn is called '뜨개질'.

examples.en: I caught a throat cold and my voice won't come out.
My throat cold was bad, so I went to the doctor.

examples.ko: 목감기 걸렸을 때는 따뜻한 물을 마셔요.
examples.en: When I have a throat cold, I drink warm water.
A throat cold should get better after a few days of rest.

examples.ko: 아이가 목감기 때문에 밥을 잘 못 먹어요.
examples.en: My child can't eat well because of a throat cold.
Every winter I'm never free of a throat cold.

explain: 목이 붓고 아프면서 기침이 나는 감기를 말해요. '코감기', '몸살감기'와 증상에 따라 나눠 불러요. '목감기에 걸리다'라고 하고, 다른 사람에게 옮을 때는 '감기가 옮다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: My sore-throat cold got better after taking medicine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병이 좋아졌을 때 '낫다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: '낫다' is the verb for recovering from an illness.

phrases.en: I felt a sore-throat cold coming on, so I went to bed early.
phrases.nuance_ko: 감기가 시작될 것 같은 느낌을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the feeling that a cold is starting.

phrases.en: I often catch a sore-throat cold in winter.
phrases.nuance_ko: '자주'를 넣어 자주 아프다고 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '자주' says that it happens often.

explain_en: It means a cold with a swollen, painful throat and coughing. People distinguish it from '코감기' and '몸살감기' by symptoms. You say '목감기에 걸리다', and when it passes from someone else you say '감기가 옮다'.

examples.en: I massage my grandmother's shoulders.
I gave my tired dad a massage.
Massaging your legs relieves tiredness.
We are massaging each other's shoulders.
I'll give my parents a massage this weekend.
I bought a machine that massages the hands.

explain: '안마하다'는 몸을 손으로 주물러 풀어 줄 때 써요. 부모님께 하면 '안마해 드리다'라고 높여요. 가게에서 받는 것은 '마사지'라는 말도 많이 써요.

phrases.en: I gave my parents a shoulder massage.
phrases.nuance_ko: 윗사람에게 해 줄 때 높여 말하는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The respectful form used when massaging an elder.

phrases.en: I'm tired, so I want to get a massage.
phrases.nuance_ko: 받는 쪽에서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used from the receiving side.

phrases.en: I got a massage on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가게에서 받는 것은 '마사지'라고 자주 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: For massages at a shop, '마사지' is often used.

explain_en: 안마하다 means kneading the body with the hands to relax it. For your parents you raise it to '안마해 드리다'. For the service you receive at a shop, the word 마사지 is also widely used.

dis.h: press and rub tired muscles by hand

p.n: 마사지 sounds more like a spa treatment than a caring rub.

examples.ko: ㄹ은 혀를 윗니 뒤에 대고 발음해요.
examples.en: You pronounce ㄹ with your tongue touching behind the upper teeth.
My upper tooth was loose, so I went to the dentist.

examples.ko: 웃을 때 윗니와 아랫니가 다 보여요.
examples.en: When I smile, both my upper and lower teeth show.
There is chili powder stuck in your upper teeth.
Try lightly biting your lower lip with your upper teeth.

examples.ko: 윗니는 아랫니보다 조금 더 앞으로 나와 있어요.
examples.en: The upper teeth stick out a little more than the lower teeth.

explain: 반대말은 '아랫니'예요. '윗'은 '위'가 아니라 '윗'으로 써서 [윈니]로 발음해요. 발음 수업이나 치과에서 자주 들을 수 있어요.

phrases.en: My upper and lower teeth fit together well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 위아래 이를 함께 말할 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pair phrase for talking about the upper and lower teeth together.

phrases.en: The baby's upper teeth have started to come in.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아기의 이가 새로 올라올 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a baby's new teeth come in.

phrases.en: Please brush your upper teeth carefully too.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이를 닦는 방법을 말할 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when talking about how to brush your teeth.

explain_en: The opposite is '아랫니' (lower teeth). It is spelled with '윗' instead of '위' and pronounced [윈니]. You often hear it in pronunciation lessons and at the dentist.

examples.ko: 살을 찌우려고 하루에 네 끼씩 먹어요.
examples.en: I eat four meals a day to gain weight.
My younger brother wants to put on weight.

examples.ko: 겨울이 오기 전에 살을 좀 찌웠어요.
examples.en: I gained some weight before winter came.

examples.ko: 살을 찌우는 것보다 빼는 게 더 어려워요.
examples.en: Losing weight is harder than gaining it.

examples.ko: 의사 선생님이 살을 조금 찌우라고 하셨어요.
examples.en: The doctor told me to put on a little weight.

examples.ko: 아기 고양이를 잘 먹여서 살을 찌웠어요.
examples.en: I fed the kitten well and fattened it up.

explain: '살이 찌다'는 저절로 살이 오르는 것이고, '살을 찌우다'는 일부러 살을 늘리거나 누군가를 살찌게 하는 거예요. 반대로 살을 줄일 때는 '살을 빼다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: These days I'm putting on weight to be healthier.
phrases.nuance_ko: '찌우다'를 해요체로 쓴 모양이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The polite present form of 찌우다.

phrases.en: I'm avoiding food that makes you gain weight.
phrases.nuance_ko: 음식이 살을 늘린다는 뜻으로 음식 이름 앞에 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes food that adds weight.

phrases.en: I want to gain weight by exercising.
phrases.nuance_ko: '살을 찌우다'보다 부드럽고 몸무게 숫자에 초점이 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Softer than 살을 찌우다 and focuses on body weight.

explain_en: '살이 찌다' is gaining weight on its own, while '살을 찌우다' is deliberately gaining weight or making someone gain it. The opposite is '살을 빼다' (lose weight).

en: to leave the hospital; to be discharged from the hospital

examples.en: My mother leaves the hospital tomorrow morning.
My grandfather left the hospital yesterday.
When are you leaving the hospital, teacher?
When you leave the hospital, rest well at home.
The doctor said I may leave the hospital.
My family came to pick me up on the day I left the hospital.

explain: 짝말은 '입원하다'예요. 병원에 들어가면 '입원', 나오면 '퇴원'이고 '병원에서 퇴원하다'처럼 '에서'를 써요. 아직 병원에 있을 때는 '입원 중이에요'라고 해요.

phrases.en: My younger sibling left the hospital after one week.
phrases.nuance_ko: '에서'를 붙여 어디에서 나오는지 분명하게 말하는 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 에서 makes clear which place the person is leaving.
phrases.en_equiv: to be discharged from the hospital

phrases.example: 의사 선생님이 내일 퇴원할 거라고 했어요.
phrases.en: The doctor said I will be discharged tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-(으)ㄹ 거예요'로 앞으로 퇴원할 계획이나 예정을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses -(으)ㄹ 거예요 to talk about a planned or expected discharge.

phrases.example: 의사 선생님이 이제 퇴원해도 된다고 했어요.
phrases.en: The doctor said I can leave the hospital now.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-아/어도 되다'로 허락이나 괜찮다는 말을 할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses -아/어도 되다 to express permission.

explain_en: Its counterpart is '입원하다'. Entering the hospital is '입원' and leaving is '퇴원', used with '에서' as in '병원에서 퇴원하다'. While someone is still in the hospital, say '입원 중이에요'.

en: to get a perm; to have one's hair permed

examples.en: I will get a perm at the salon tomorrow.
I got my hair permed yesterday.
My hair looks much fuller since I got a perm.
My mother gets her hair permed every two months.
Permed hair needs good care.

examples.ko: 파마하고 나니까 아침에 머리 손질이 쉬워졌어요.
examples.en: After getting a perm, styling my hair in the morning became easier.

explain: '머리를 파마하다'라고도 하고 '파마를 하다'라고도 해요. 파마한 머리를 '파마머리'라고 불러요.

phrases.en: I'm going to get a perm this weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: '파마하다'를 둘로 나눈 말이에요. 뜻은 같아요.
phrases.nuance_en: '파마하다' split into two words; the meaning is the same.

phrases.en: I got my hair permed and I look different.
phrases.nuance_ko: 무엇을 파마했는지 '머리'를 넣어 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adds '머리' to say what was permed.

phrases.en: Permed hair suits my younger sibling well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 파마를 한 머리 모양을 가리키는 명사예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A noun for hair that has been permed.

explain_en: You can say 머리를 파마하다 or 파마를 하다. Permed hair is called 파마머리.
